releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 288: Private Locker Pattern/Fingerprint setup, removal and Lock Off/Lock On controls are placed above Search and outside the writing area. Existing lock handlers, PIN confirmation and saved data are unchanged.
